It is the only native GLO industrial medium-voltage grid in the two inspected releases. Source historical generation is91.090396%non-pumped hydropower,while native aluminium generation has54%hydropower. This is a major generation/sector/geographic model difference that can materially change scores; the source generation profile is not reproduced. The native globally labelled record uses EAA2013/2010 industry data and partly European plant proxies. Retain its complete model rather than claiming industry labels imply equivalent supplies.

Source nominal generator input is1.0074/((1-0.0046)*(1-0.0335))=1.0471344595kWh per delivered medium-voltage kWh. Native upstream input is1.0123*1.04=1.052792. Native uncertain grid coefficients,network infrastructure and emissions remain in the complete model without fixed foreground cancellation or reconstructed correlations. Shared Premise explicitly preserves cobalt/aluminium industry names,and GLO is outside the aluminium-specific regions that are redirected; this proxy therefore preserves the existing industrial-market treatment.
